parole.significato: trash, leftovers, refuse (what is designated as bad; what is is leftover after what is good is taken)
parole.testo: Inherited from Old Czech brak, from Middle Low German brak. Compare Polish brak.

parole.significato: a type of small fishing net
parole.testo: Inherited from Old Czech keser, borrowed from Middle Low German kesser. See German Kescher.

parole.significato: brine (a salt and water solution for pickling)
parole.testo: Inherited from Old Czech lák, from Middle Low German lāke
